title: One Pan Chicken Lasagna

items: 400 grams tomatoes, blended in a mixer

method: Add oil to the pan with the garlic, onion and cook
Then add in mushrooms and allow to cook
tips: Need to cut carbs? add in half the lasagna, it still tastes great and gives a higher protein to carb ratio
To make it veg, replace chicken with crumbled tofu/paneer and add in heartier vegetables i:e eggplant, zucchini to the mix

caption:
One Pan Chicken Lasagna 
one pot recipe | high protein | low fat | stove top | meal prep friendly 

follow @ellasrecipebook_ for more <3 

Nutrition: 
C: 59 | F: 15 | P: 51
Calories: 564 per serving 
Makes 3 large portions can be divided into 4 portions also 

Ingredients
1 tsp olive oil 
450 grams chicken mince
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 large onion, diced
2 carrots, grated
1 capsicum, small cubed
200 grams button mushroom, sliced
400 grams tomatoes, blended in a mixer
1 1/2 cup vegetable stock
120 grams lasagna sheets
salt + pepper, to taste
1 tbsp red chilli flakes
1 tbsp oregano
75 grams cheddar cheese

Method
add oil to the pan with the garlic, onion and cook
then add in mushrooms and allow to cook 
follow that up with the carrot and capsicum and cook for a few minutes
add in the chicken mince and allow to cook through in the mix 
add in salt + pepper + red chilli flakes + italian spices as you prefer 
add in the blended tomatoes and vegetable stock and mix together
add in the broken lasagna sheets, mix it into the mix and cover the pot
let it cook for 10 minutes 
your lasagna is ready once the sheets are cooked well
top with grated cheese and dig in 

pro tips: 
need to cut carbs? add in half the lasagna, it still tastes great and gives a higher protein to carb ratio 
to make it veg, replace chicken with crumbled tofu/paneer and add in heartier vegetables i:e eggplant, zucchini to the mix
if you want a more traditional finish, add on 100 grams of white sauce before you add the cheese though it will increase the calories by a bit else add a dollop of garlic cream cheese to top while eating to give you creaminess!!
